description:
Requests a password-reset email for a player without disclosing whether the email is registered.
Use when: the player explicitly requests password recovery for this email address.
Not for: account discovery, repeated email sends or resetting the password itself (use horizon_reset_password).
Side effects: may send a reset email and replace the previous reset token. Never automatically repeat an uncertain request.
Returns: empty HTTP 200 represented as null regardless of whether the email exists; it does not prove delivery or account existence.
Errors: 400 for an invalid email; common API errors are surfaced without attempting automatic retries. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

email.description: Player's email address for the explicitly requested password recovery (max 254 characters)

name: horizon_forgot_password
title: Request Player Password Reset
